ios.desc:
Swift Paperless is a native iOS app that interacts with the popular Paperless-ngx document management software. Paperless-ngx is self-hosted, and therefore fully privacy preserving: you control your data!

With Swift Paperless, it's easy to find, categorize and also add documents from your phone!
